node.label: Frog-leg posture
node.definition: A type of rest posture in an infant that indicated a generalized reduction in muscle tone. The hips are flexed and the legs are abducted to an extent that causes the lateral thigh to rest upon the supporting surface. This posture is said to resemble the legs of a frog.

evidence.snippet: Pyruvate dehydrogenase E2 deficiency: Frog-leg posture (frequency HP:0040282) [TAS]
